item.title: @faytuksnetwork: Trump said earlier this week on Hugh Hewitt's show that he wants to "get Cuba done" before leaving office, and when aske
item.description:
Trump said earlier this week on Hugh Hewitt's show that he wants to "get Cuba done" before leaving office, and when asked about a week long military campaign, said "I would certainly consider that, yes."
Cuba's Díaz-Canel responded yesterday that Havana is “preparing to reject” any foreign military aggression.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

Trump said earlier this week on Hugh Hewitt's show that he wants to "get Cuba done" before leaving office, and when asked about a week long military campaign, said "I would certainly consider that, yes." Cuba's Díaz-Canel responded yesterday that Havana is “preparing to reject” any foreign military aggression.

item.description: U.S., Japanese, Australian and Indian leaders are expected to hold a Quad summit Tuesday in Manila, reports Reuters. The first leaders’ meeting in two years is expected to address critical minerals and maritime security amid concerns about Chinese regional influence.
